description:
What the absence of petrol stations, fast food and bottle shops near sold properties was worth.

**NSW-only coverage:** this is modelled from NSW sales, so a suburb in any
other state returns no data (and is not billed). A premium of $0
with 0% coverage means every recent sale had that amenity nearby (typical of
dense inner suburbs), not a missing figure.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
